scope: Scoped Linux x86_64 GNU real unprivileged UDP sendmmsg+recvmmsg ready-outcome and generation-held delayed lease. Not a real raw AF_PACKET or Go V4 delivery system.

implementation.adapter: ScopedUdpOwner composes existing native sendmmsg submit_connected_udp, native recvmmsg receive_ready_udp and Arc<BorrowFence>; validates nonzero generation, connected sender, borrowed sockets and strictly caller-owned buffers.
implementation.outcomes: Returns BatchResult for exactly classified accepted kernel-copied prefix, None/Some uncertain index and not-attempted suffix. 33rd frame untouched and submitted separately; no retry of uncertain by default. Accepted is not a peer ACK. RX outcome distinguishes complete vs truncated/unused and status AtCap/WouldBlock; parsers cannot accept truncated records.
implementation.memory: No new hot-path syscall, per-batch heap frame copy, lock, per-frame Arc clone or record reseal. The separate GenerationLoan owns one frozen record in preexisting KernelLoan for delayed driver completion; generation mismatch returns same loan to caller, without dropping memory. STOP idempotent, pending until old token actually completed. Existing copied UDP send does not invent asynchronous kernel retention.
implementation.hot_path: Owned sender/receiver socket and Arc<BorrowFence> created cold. Send/receive use original single direct native syscall in existing M4 modules with <=32 fixed stack syscall descriptors. Ready socket frames are passed as read-only borrowed handles, RX buffers are caller preallocated.
implementation.negative_and_limitations: EINTR is only validated in existing deterministic pure classifiers, not kernel-injected in this test. UnixDatagram real kernel backpressure EAGAIN checked by existing prior tests. Native AF_PACKET CAP_NET_RAW negative EPERM child remains PASS; positive raw RX is RAW_RX_NOT_RUN on runner.

native.audit: Both original exact-run ZIPs downloaded directly and independently SHA256 verified, including contained manifest, compiled-once test executable, result.json and test.log. Same source SHA, run, attempt, binary SHA, 71 case list, actual 71 ok 0 failed 7 old R0 filtered. stderr RAW_RX_NOT_RUN due CAP_NET_RAW absence.
